title: Bind summary counters and source-caught-up metadata to one materialized snapshot
finding: catchUp spreads view from materialized.read, but derives source_cursor and purpose-exclusion counters from a second aggregate read. A concurrent source fold+ACK can make that aggregate and the later index boundary both N+1 while view counters and revision still describe N. The returned and subsequently persisted summary may claim CURRENT/source_caught_up with stale counters.
